subject: Orchid Labs renewal: committed throughput band elevation and rate-gate coordination

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Orchid Labs renewal: committed throughput increase inquiry

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Hope you9re both well. Quick context: Orchid is launching two new multimodal features in Q3 and we expect sustained generation volume to increase ~2.5x. Our current hosted commit is starting to feel restrictive for predictable latency and cost planning.

Can you share:
- Options to increase our monthly committed throughput and any tiered discounts for a higher band?
- How rate limits and soft-throttles behave during spikes if we move up a tier?
- Timeline to lock new terms (we9d like this in place before July invoicing).

We9re flexible on staged ramps (e.g., step-up over 60 days) if that helps capacity planning. Also looping in Maya (engineering lead) for any technical constraints.

Thanks,
Sasha Park
Head of Product, Orchid Labs
Sasha Park | sasha@orchid.ai | +1 415-555-0192

[Note: attaching sample traffic curves in follow-up if useful]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid Labs renewal: committed throughput increase inquiry

Hi Sasha 26 Maya,

Thanks for the heads up2E We9ve reviewed Orchid9s usage patterns and put together two practical paths so you can balance cost predictability and burst tolerance:

Option A  Immediate band elevation (recommended for steady 2x+ growth)
- Increase monthly committed tokens from 1.2B -> 2.6B
- Unit price: ~10% discount off current band (reflects committed uplift)
- Rate gating: bump soft-rate gate from 12k TPS -> 20k TPS per customer shard; automatic fallback to compatible model variant if sustained overage > 10 min
- Timeline: contract amendment + DocuSign -> 7 business days after sign-off; ops provisioning immediate after Docusign completion

Option B  Phased ladder (lower near-term cost, faster start)
- Month 1-2: 1.6B commit, Month 3: 2.2B, Month 4 onward: 2.6B
- Lower upfront commit discount (5%) but phased provisioning to limit wasted capacity during ramp

Attachments and links:
- [Attachment: Orchid_renewal_proposal_v3.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]  contains pricing schedule, SLA changes, and our recommended rollout cadence
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7832

A few operational notes:
- Burst capacity: both options include a burst window (up to 40% over commit) billed as overage; we can add a pre-purchased burst pocket if you want hard limits on overage spend.
- Latency SLOs: we will preserve current p50/p95 targets; for ultra-low-latency traffic we recommend pinning a model variant in the contract to avoid automatic fallbacks.

Next steps:
1) Tell me which option you prefer by EOD 2028-06-05.
2) If you approve Option A we9ll route to Legal for amendment and send the DocuSign powerform (link included).
3) Ops: once signed, Marissa will schedule the provisioning window and confirm rate-gate thresholds.

Happy to jump on a 30m call if you want to walk through the proposal.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 503-555-0147

[Attachment referenced: Orchid_renewal_proposal_v3.pdf]

Thanks Irene  appreciate the clear options. A couple of clarifying questions before we sign: 

1) Billing cadence and PO support: our procurement needs a single invoice and PO reference for the new commit; can you support Net30 and include PO# on the invoice?
2) Burst pocket mechanics: if we pre-purchase a 200M-token burst pocket, is unused burst credited to the next month or forfeited?
3) Compliance/region: we must have data processing and logs retained in us-west region for the next 12 months; will the amendment explicitly call this out? We9re also preparing a SOC2 attestation request (can we get a copy of your latest SOC2 Type II report during contracting?).

If those answers look good we9ll move forward with Option A. One more ask: can you confirm the ops provisioning window won9t require downtime or changes to our integration?
